counterexample: x = (y*x)*(x*(y*y)) has models of every order 1..6 (EXP-C05-01); of order 2 it is satisfied by NAND (Lean: nand2_law), yet no affine operation over Z_2 satisfies it (Lean: no_affine_model_mod2); its affine models exist only for n in {1, 5}. Three further identities behave alike (EXP-C05-05).
statement: A nontrivial identity t = x has models of all orders 1..6 iff it has an affine model x*y = a x + b y + c over Z_n for every n <= 6.
title: H-C05-A: full spectrum iff affine models over every Z_n (refuted)
